title: publication-bias-v1 task input
description: A meta-analytic dataset: a set of studies, each contributing one effect-size estimate (yi) and its standard error (sei). The player must judge whether the set as a whole shows small-study / publication bias (funnel-plot asymmetry). At least 10 studies per task so an Egger-style asymmetry test is meaningful.

k.description: Convenience count of studies (== studies.length). Optional; the authoritative count is the length of the studies array.

studies.description: One entry per study contributing an effect size and its standard error.

yi.description: Effect-size estimate for this study (on the analysis scale, e.g. a standardized mean difference or log odds ratio).

sei.description: Standard error of yi for this study (sei > 0). Variance vi = sei^2.
